netlist:
C Cin VIN1 n1
L Lg n1 n2
NMOS M1 n3 n2 n4 VSS
L Ls n4 n5
L Ld VDD n3
C Ct1 n3 n6
C Cout n6 VOUT1
rationale: The proposed topology improves the binding constraint—NF (noise figure)—by incorporating a source degeneration inductor (Ls) in series with the NMOS source, which enhances input matching and reduces noise while maintaining sufficient gain. The addition of a small gate inductor (Lg) improves high-frequency stability and input reflection, addressing the poor S11 and S21 simultaneously. This configuration leverages the 45nm process's ability to support small inductors and maintains the device budget. The inductor-based source degeneration provides better noise performance than resistive degeneration without increasing power, which is critical for meeting the NF ≤ 2.5 dB requirement.
